_metadata.description: OT-P0-001 — structured plan + phase record persisted to a durable, scenario-independent home store.

requirements.title: A plan is a first-class structured record with ordered first-class phases
requirements.description: A plan is stored as a structured record (meta + global sections + ordered phases; each phase owns relevant context, reminders, baseline scope, acceptance, and status) and exposes CRUD plus a rendered markdown view. Persistence is rooted at the scenario-independent ~/.vrooli home store so plans remain readable when the plan-manager server is down.

validation.notes: Plan + phase round-trip through the SQLite repository.
Structured plans render to deterministic markdown with machine-readable references.
Plans can be imported and migrated through the store-backed service seam.

requirements.title: Phase status is a computed runtime transition, never agent-edited markdown
requirements.description: Phase status (todo / active / done / blocked) changes only through a typed state transition (or inference from acceptance/validation passing). The rendered markdown view reflects status but is never the source of truth, so an agent cannot corrupt plan state by editing prose.

validation.notes: Typed phase transitions compute plan status and archive remains terminal.
